title: PsiloSoma Dataset – Occurrence and Ethnomycological Data on Psilocybe spp. (2022–2024)
description: Curated occurrence and contextual data associated with selected Psilocybe records documented between 2022 and 2024 as part of the PsiloSoma Project, integrating original field observations and literature-derived records in a Darwin Core-aligned CSV structure.
ethicalAndLegalNote: This dataset is intended for scientific, naturalistic, educational and conservation-related purposes only. It does not promote consumption, cultivation, trade, recreational use, unauthorized collection or practical use of any organism.
geoprivacyNote: Sensitive localities, protected areas or records requiring caution may be obscured, generalized or managed according to geoprivacy, conservation, authorization and data-sensitivity requirements.
